import os, sys, json, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT=Path('/app/output'); CAMS=['head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1']

def save_result(res, index):
    d=OUT/f'run_{index:03d}'
    res.save(str(d))
    np.savez(d/'obs_arrays.npz', **{f'rgb_{k}':v for k,v in res.last.items()}, **{f'depth_{k}':v for k,v in res.depth.items()})
    montage=Image.new('RGB',(640,3*260))
    for i,cam in enumerate(CAMS):
        if cam in res.last:
            im=Image.fromarray(res.last[cam]); x=(i%2)*320; y=(i//2)*260
            montage.paste(im,(x,y+20)); ImageDraw.Draw(montage).text((x+5,y+3),cam,fill='white')
    montage.save(d/'montage.png')
    (OUT/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'index':index,'meta':res.meta},indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({'index':index,'meta':res.meta}),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    robot=Robot()
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(robot.spec(),indent=2))
    i=0
    res=robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True)
    save_result(res,i)
    while not res.done:
        p=OUT/'command.json'
        if not p.exists():
            time.sleep(.1); continue
        cmd=json.loads(p.read_text()); p.unlink(); i+=1
        (OUT/f'command_{i:03d}.json').write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2))
        try:
            if cmd['op']=='obs':
                res=robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,seconds=cmd.get('seconds',0),include_depth=True,video=cmd.get('video','frames'))
            else:
                res=robot.submit(cmd['op'],cmd['actions'],dt=cmd.get('dt',.05),cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='both',note=cmd.get('note',''))
            save_result(res,i)
        except Exception as e:
            print(json.dumps({'index':i,'error':str(e)}),flush=True)
            traceback.print_exc()
            break
PY
